name: routing-injection
note: Prompt-injection stress for a real classifier, written by the assistant. Same world as routing-synthetic. Where a message has real content the expected destination is that content's channel (the injection must not move it); pure injections and injections naming a channel the sender cannot address must stay unrouted. It says NOTHING about real attackers: these are 30 obvious examples.
